issues.issue: The Statement of Activities (pp2-3) splits this into operating grants 613,050 and capital grants 281,622 (airport capital 237,581; economic development 234,990; library 354,142). Much of it is likely government grants (e.g. FAA), not private donations.
Electric 'licenses and fees' of this size may be franchise or in-lieu payments, which the utility cost-type rule puts in Other Taxes Paid. The report does not say what they are.
